ideas.name: Body Neutrality as Standard
ideas.promise: All supported base body silhouettes, builds, heights, skin tones, basic face and essential representation options free
ideas.enforcement: No checkout SKU, subscription or gated entitlement may be required for a base body configuration
ideas.current_evidence: Five shape profiles, nine height profiles and ten build profiles are previewed in a local CSS studio
ideas.not_proven: All real hand-drawn base silhouettes are not yet produced or fitted

ideas.name: Artist-Authored Inclusive Canvas
ideas.promise: Original sketch master and an artist-approved chain of enhancements for future production art
ideas.enforcement: Original private sketch plus source SHA, author licence, reviewed AI-enhanced layer and human sign-off before publication
ideas.current_evidence: Source cleanup CLI and metadata spec have been drafted
ideas.not_proven: Human origin of a specific future scanned sketch or absence of AI artefacts

ideas.name: Inclusive Fashion, No Body-Size Surcharge
ideas.promise: Optional outfits/accessories at the same product price regardless of avatar body size
ideas.enforcement: Review every paid garment against all supported body-fit profiles, reject clipped or excluded silhouettes or paid corrective fit layers
ideas.current_evidence: Normalized anchor profiles and 450-parametric-combination checks are proposed
ideas.not_proven: Visual garment fit or actual unit economics; no evidence buyers will pay NZ$5
